launch_application: launch a dm_control viewer application with an environment loader and optional policy
create_help_view: create a Help view model that returns keyboard shortcut columns for the viewer
create_status_monitor: create a Status model to monitor FPS, CPU time, camera, and pause state
restart_runtime: restart the viewer runtime to reset the environment, model, and policy state
advance_simulation: advance the simulation by a single step when the runtime is active
